pool.description: pool to report on, default the tenant default pool

tools.description: List the model column catalog visible to the tenant (provider, model, endpoint, settings, status, pricing, deprecation), mirroring GET /v1/models.

tools.description: Recommend the best model column for a workload, mirroring POST /v1/recommend. Prefer the declared workload form ({capability, difficulty?, domain_tags?}) whenever you already know the capability: it is faster and nothing leaves the session. Use the prompt form ({prompt}) only when the capability is unknown and classification is needed.

capability.description: declared form: one of the ten v1 capabilities

domain_tags.description: declared form: domain tags such as legal or medical

prompt.description: prompt form: the raw prompt to classify

pool.description: pool to recommend from, default the tenant default pool

allowed_models.description: restrict candidates to these model ids

mode.description: quality, balanced, or cost; default balanced

max_cost_per_run.description: preference: maximum cost per run in USD

max_latency_ms.description: preference: maximum p95 latency in milliseconds

tools.name: recommend_model
